sentences.en: The local charitable organization helps homeless animals find new homes.
sentences.zh: 当地的慈善机构帮助无家可归的动物找到新家。

sentences.en: She volunteers at a charitable organization that supports underprivileged children.
sentences.zh: 她在一个支持贫困儿童的慈善机构做志愿者。

sentences.en: Many companies donate to charitable organizations during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 许多公司在节假日向慈善机构捐款。
